caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular, stone-like object with carved relief and inscriptions, rendered in shades of gray and black pencil on an off-white background. The relief in the upper portion shows three human figures standing side by side in shallow profile, each with distinguishable head and body shapes, and some detailing suggesting clothing or hats. Above the figures is a horizontal, undulating pattern. Below the figures, there are two lines of engraved text: the first line reads "MARLBRO FURNACE," and the second line displays the year "1768." The rectangular stone is framed with a slightly raised border. The composition is centered on the page with ample blank space surrounding the depicted object, and there are patches of discoloration visible at the upper left and right corners of the background.
title: Pa. German Stove Plate
